import gc, hashlib, importlib.metadata, json, runpy, time
from pathlib import Path
import torch
from transformers.integrations.flex_attention import WrappedFlexAttention, flex_attention
config = json.loads(Path("/work/research/irc-static-oracle-config-v1.json").read_text())
for path, digest in config["source_sha256"].items():
    assert hashlib.sha256((Path("/work") / path).read_bytes()).hexdigest() == digest
for path, digest in config["runtime_files_sha256"].items():
    assert hashlib.sha256(Path(path).read_bytes()).hexdigest() == digest
for name, version in config["package_versions"].items():
    assert importlib.metadata.version(name) == version
assert torch.cuda.is_available()
test = runpy.run_path("/work/tests/test_attention_backend.py")["test_native_fp32_prefill_backward_matches_grouped_fp64"]
wrapper = WrappedFlexAttention(False)
compiled = torch.compile(flex_attention, dynamic=False)
wrapper._compiled_flex_attention = compiled
original_check = torch.testing.assert_close
checks = []
def recorded_check(actual, expected, **kwargs):
    difference = (actual - expected).abs()
    tolerance = kwargs["atol"] + kwargs["rtol"] * expected.abs()
    record = {"shape": list(actual.shape), "elements": actual.numel(), "max_absolute_error": difference.max().item(), "max_error_over_tolerance": (difference / tolerance).max().item(), "rtol": kwargs["rtol"], "atol": kwargs["atol"]}
    checks.append(record)
    original_check(actual, expected, **kwargs)
torch.testing.assert_close = recorded_check
results = []
for index, length in enumerate(config["shape_history"]):
    checks.clear()
    torch.cuda.synchronize()
    started = time.perf_counter()
    try:
        test(length=length, query_heads=32, kv_heads=8, training=False)
        status, error = "pass", None
    except AssertionError as failure:
        status, error = "fail", str(failure)
    torch.cuda.synchronize()
    assert wrapper._compiled_flex_attention is compiled and not wrapper.training
    row = {"event": "static_oracle_case", "index": index, "length": length, "batch": 2, "query_heads": 32, "kv_heads": 8, "head_dim": 128, "training": False, "status": status, "error": error, "checks": list(checks), "seconds": time.perf_counter() - started, "compiler_callable_unchanged": True}
    print(json.dumps(row, allow_nan=False), flush=True)
    results.append(row)
    gc.collect()
    torch.cuda.empty_cache()
torch.testing.assert_close = original_check
passed = len(results) == 4 and all(row["status"] == "pass" and len(row["checks"]) == 4 for row in results)
print(json.dumps({"event": "static_oracle_terminal", "status": "pass" if passed else "fail", "cases": len(results), "passed_cases": sum(row["status"] == "pass" for row in results), "compiler_callable_unchanged": True, "old_trajectory_parity_restored": False, "baseline_eligible": False}), flush=True)
if not passed:
    raise RuntimeError("Separately declared static FP64 oracle contract failed")
